PCI.BIO: Dr. Mustapha Rahmaninezhad has received his Ph.D. degree with honors in Civil Engineering from the University of Kansas. He has more than three years of industrial as a senior geotechnical engineer and more than 12 years of research experience. His research interests consist of geosynthetics, earth structures, buried structures, and geo-environmental engineering. He has published about 30 peer-reviewed papers in international journals and conference proceedings. He received the 2017 Practice-Ready Paper Award from the Transportation Research Board (TRB), the 2019 Sweet-Sixteen High-Value Research Award from the American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials (AASHTO), and the Geosynthetic Institute (GSI) Fellowship in 2018. He also was nominated for the Outstanding Researcher Award, class 2019, at the University of Kansas. He is a member of the Transportation Earthwork Committee of TRB.
